holderQuote: “[Highborn] Vaitsha Zectiou. I am Vaitsha, daughter of Germina. I will witness the Quarass.”
She was one of the richest of the [Highborn] in the city. A powerful woman.
The voice came from behind Flos. He turned and looked at Vaitsha. The [Highborn] lady stared hatred at him. The King returned her glance as if she were an ant.
“Rise, Vaitsha. I am the Quarass. And you are one of my three. What is it you have to say?”
Her [Highborn], one of the three protectors who had sworn to serve her by blood, Vaitsha, had already begun her change.
The pale-faced [Highborn]’s eyes flickered. Her face was pale white, but there were darker shades visible under the skin.
Khalid, the Quarass’ [Champion], and Vaitsha, her [Highborn]
